transcript: Hello control room, Raman here from Piping. We have completed spool erection on line 24-CW-001 up to spool SP-106 on rack 4. Out of 8 spools, 6 are erected and bolted. Remaining two cannot be lifted today because the 50-ton mobile crane hydraulic line ruptured. Crane mechanic is on site, expecting hose replacement by tomorrow 10 AM. Current progress roughly seventy-five percent.

Civil supervisor Debojit reporting. Curing and final foundation inspection for Booster Pump Pad P-12 is hundred percent complete today. Client QC has signed off the test cube reports. Mechanical team can take over for pump positioning anytime from tomorrow.

Bikash from Electrical side. We pulled two hundred and forty meters of eleven kV power cable in tray B along the trench today. Total run is five hundred meters, so progress is about forty-eight percent. Sand bedding was laid in the morning shift.

Piping crew tried to start fit-up of pump discharge line 16-DIS-002, but the required three hundred pound spiral wound gaskets have not arrived from store. Activity is stalled waiting for material clearance.
